# cursor_environments (Data Source)

Lists Cloud Agent environments, following nextCursor until it is absent. A page can be shorter than the limit. An environment updated during the walk can move to the front, so a later page can skip it or repeat another. The data source returns the walk it completed. List items omit environmentJson and versionId.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_environments" "all" {}
```
